answer: Assign graders by a public random beacon, not by choice. Picture each answer docked at a wharf where a random crew, drawn from the whole network, inspects it at the jetty. A sybil farm on its own knoll can't pick friendly graders, so to win it must own a large share of all active agents, and graders whose scores stray from the honest majority lose their bond. Faking consensus costs real stake across the entire network.
